Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

Descrição da vaga

CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit‑ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

  • Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability.

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment).
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

  • Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
  • Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.
  • Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.
  • Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.
  • Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.
  • Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.
  • Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.
  • Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP.
  • Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.
  • Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP/Oracle) and BI/reporting tools.
  • Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.
  • High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).
  • MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).
  • Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

Referência em saúde, destaque em gestão de pessoas e liderança feminina, dedicado às melhores práticas sustentáveis e atuante nas comunidades onde está presente, o Grupo Sabin nasceu na capital federal, fruto da coragem e determinação de duas empreendedoras, Janete Vaz e Sandra Soares Costa, em 1984. Hoje conta com cerca de 7000 colaboradores unidos pelo propósito de inspirar pessoas a cuidar de pessoas.

Presente em 14 estados, além do Distrito Federal, a empresa oferece serviços de saúde com excelência, inovação e responsabilidade socioambiental às 354 unidades distribuídas de norte a sul do país.

O ecossistema de saúde do Grupo Sabin integra um portfólio de negócios que contempla análises clínicas, diagnósticos por imagem, anatomia patológica, genômica, imunização e check-up executivo. Além disso, contempla também serviços de atenção primária, contribuindo para a gestão de saúde de grupos populacionais por meio de programas e linhas de cuidados coordenados, com a Amparo Saúde, e a plataforma integradora de serviços de saúde - Rita Saúde - solução digital que conta com diversos parceiros como farmácias, médicos e outros profissionais, promovendo acesso à saúde com qualidade e eficiência.

Com o objetivo de fomentar o empreendedorismo na saúde, o Grupo lançou, em 2020, o SkyHub.Bio – um hub de inovação que atua na promoção e no desenvolvimento de startups, estimulando parcerias, troca de conhecimento e a construção de modelos de negócio que contribuam para o setor de saúde com base na ciência, eficiência e experiência do cliente.

Como uma empresa nacional sólida, visionária, com valores bem estabelecidos, comprometida com uma agenda ESG de forma genuína e serviços de saúde e bem-estar para apoiar a jornada de saúde de seus clientes, de Norte a Sul do país, o Grupo Sabin é mantenedor do Instituto Sabin, que desde 2005 trabalha ações de impacto social nas comunidades onde a empresa está presente, com foco na melhoria da qualidade de vida, do bem-estar e da prosperidade dessas comunidades, fomentando a inovação social. Nessa trajetória o Instituto impactou positivamente a vida de mais de 1,6 milhões de pessoas e 902 organizações sociais.

Conheça nossos processos seletivos, fique por dentro das vagas disponíveis nas unidades Sabin espalhadas por todo Brasil. Afinal, investimos em processos formulados para trazer para o nosso Grupo pessoas engajadas com nosso propósito e valores.

Fique atento e evite cair em golpes! Não cobramos quaisquer valores para a participação em nossos processos seletivos em qualquer etapa.

Own and drive end‑to‑end technical implementation projects and workstreams as assigned. On an ongoing basis, support and execute against the team’s enhancement roadmap for systems, tools, and processes.

In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.

Engage with stakeholders — Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others — to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status. Risk Management

Identify technical risks related to implementation considerations for assigned projects. Assist in developing mitigation strategies with technical partners.

Dependency Management

Identify, document, and track dependencies within the scope of your projects and across adjacent teams. Proactively coordinate with stakeholders to ensure dependencies are clearly understood and addressed.

Tooling and Data Hygiene

Accordingly, ensure the use of standard project management tools — ideally within the Atlassian suite — and maintain high standards of data hygiene to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Support accurate and transparent reporting and on‑target capitalization within the organization through data stewardship.

Delivery and Outcome Tracking

Track project performance against the committed plan and goals. Use data and metrics to support decision‑making and continuous improvement at the project level.

Experience you’ll bring

Relevant experience in technical program management managing projects or complex sub‑initiatives focused on internal tooling and capabilities. An ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen and strong project management skills to drive execution within cross‑functional initiatives. They are comfortable working in ambiguous or fast‑paced environments and excel at executing detailed project plans. They are passionate about implementing solutions and communicating effectively with project and mid‑level stakeholders.

Leadership and Communication

Problem‑Solving

Buscamos Nutricionistas para integrar nossa clínica e atuar diretamente no cuidado nutricional de pacientes com enxaqueca, com foco em avaliação individualizada, identificação de gatilhos alimentares e construção de estratégias alimentares sustentáveis.

Esta posição é ideal para quem combina raciocínio clínico, comunicação empática e interesse genuíno por neurociência da dor, saúde intestinal, comportamento alimentar e cuidado baseado em evidências.

Para ter sucesso no cargo, será importante conduzir atendimentos com método, registrar e acompanhar indicadores clínicos, colaborar com a equipe multiprofissional e transformar recomendações em planos práticos, realistas e aderentes à rotina de cada paciente.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar consultas nutricionais com foco em pacientes com enxaqueca (anamnese completa, avaliação de rotina, histórico de crises, padrões alimentares e estilo de vida).
  • Identificar possíveis gatilhos alimentares e não alimentares relacionados às crises, com abordagem individualizada e sem restrições desnecessárias.
  • Elaborar planos alimentares personalizados para pacientes com enxaqueca, considerando necessidades clínicas, preferências, cultura alimentar, orçamento e rotina.
  • Planejar e conduzir protocolos nutricionais de suporte ao manejo da enxaqueca quando aplicável (ex.: regularidade alimentar, hidratação, cafeína, sono, estratégias de estabilização glicêmica, ajustes de fibras, suporte gastrointestinal).
  • Orientar sobre suplementos e recursos nutricionais quando indicados, respeitando diretrizes, segurança, interações e condutas baseadas em evidências.
  • Acompanhar evolução clínica por meio de metas e indicadores (ex.: frequência/intensidade das crises, adesão, sintomas gastrointestinais, comportamento alimentar, qualidade do sono e energia).
  • Registrar atendimentos em prontuário, elaborar relatórios e manter documentação organizada conforme padrões internos e éticos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe da clínica (ex.: médicos(as), fisioterapeutas, psicologia ou outras especialidades), alinhando condutas e melhorando a jornada de cuidado.
  • Desenvolver materiais educativos e orientações práticas para pacientes (guias, checklists, listas de substituições, estratégias para crises e rotina).
  • Participar de discussões clínicas, reuniões e treinamentos internos para atualização e padronização do atendimento.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em Nutrição e registro ativo no CRN.
  • Experiência clínica em consultório/ambulatório com atendimentos individualizados.
  • Vivência ou forte interesse em atuar com pacientes com enxaqueca e dor crônica (diferencial: experiência comprovada com esse público).
  • Conhecimento prático em investigação de padrões alimentares e possíveis gatilhos relacionados à enxaqueca, com postura crítica e baseada em evidências.
  • Boa comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir mudanças de hábito com foco em adesão e autonomia do paciente.
  • Organização para gestão de agenda, registros em prontuário e acompanhamento longitudinal.
  • Certificações/cursos na área serão considerados diferenciais (ex.: nutrição clínica, comportamento alimentar, saúde intestinal, suplementação baseada em evidências, dor crônica/neurologia, ou áreas correlatas).

We are seeking a skilled Senior Microsoft 365 Migration Specialist with proven experience planning and executing migrations across Microsoft cloud workloads.   • Plan and execute data migrations across Microsoft 365 workloads with minimal disruption to business operations. This includes applying expertise in M365 / O365 tenant management, licensing optimization, and customization.

  • Map identities between environments using Active Directory (AD) and Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), ensuring security enhancements and seamless SSO integration across Microsoft services.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to permissions, throttling, unsupported features, or migration failures.
  • Maintain documentation and reporting for migration status, logs, and validation.

Main requirements

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration and migrations, with expertise in tenant management, migrations, licensing optimization, and customization.

  • Hands‑on experience with Migration tools such as Sharegate, BitTitan, etc.
  • Working knowledge of Exchange Online migrations.
  • Familiarity with native Microsoft tools for PST ingestion and data import.
  • Understanding of SharePoint Online architecture, site collections, document libraries, and permission models.
  • Proficiency with Azure AD, Azure storage accounts, and authentication models, including identity management, security enhancements, and seamless SSO integration.
  • Experience with Intune for comprehensive mobile device management (MDM) and compliance policies.
  • Experience with OneDrive setup, optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience working in enterprise‑scale environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS‑100, MS‑101, SC‑300, AZ‑104)
  • Scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell) for bulk operations or automation
  • Experience with Microsoft Teams implementation, governance, and cross‑service migrations.
  • Exposure to hybrid environments (on‑prem AD with Azure AD Sync)

Benefits & Perks

Why Jolera

title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
At Hostelworld (Permanent), in Porto, Portugal. Expires at: . Remote policy: Full remote.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Hostelworld operates a matrixed structure, with Growth teams comprising Technology, Product, Marketing and Analytics & Insights (A&I), all aligned to common objectives.

This role sits within the A&I function and partners closely with the Mobile Growth organisation, supporting multiple sub-teams including Chat, Travel Plans, Core Experience, Inventory Expansion, Monetisation and CRM. These teams collectively own the mobile customer journey and are central to Hostelworld’s growth strategy.

The Principal Decision Scientist acts as the senior analytics lead across Mobile Growth, providing technical direction, strategic insight, and analytical governance to ensure consistent, high-quality decision-making across pods.

The core toolset includes Snowflake & DBT for data modelling and transformation, Tableau for BI reporting, and mobile platforms such as Firebase, Appsflyer, Iterable and Sendbird.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Act as the senior analytical authority for Mobile Growth, providing guidance on measurement strategy, data dependencies, and best practice
  • Translate complex data into strategic insights that inform Product, Growth and commercial decision‑making
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape roadmaps and define success metrics
  • Lead analytics design for complex or high‑risk initiatives (e.g. attribution changes, architecture updates, major Mobile feature launches)
  • Ensure data quality, tracking integrity, and alignment across Firebase, Appsflyer, Iterable, Sendbird and downstream reporting
  • Provide coaching and non‑line‑management mentorship to analysts across six Mobile Growth sub‑teams
  • Drive knowledge sharing through documentation, forums and best‑practice guidance
  • Improve analytics delivery through prioritisation frameworks, process optimisation and workflow managementSupport coordination of analytics demand across multiple Product teams
  • Lead or contribute to wider A&I functional improvement initiatives

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years’ experience in commercial data analytics, ideally within mobile‑first, product‑led or e‑commerce environments
  • Deep expertise in SQL and data modelling using modern data stacks (Snowflake, DBT)
  • Strong experience with mobile analytics platforms such as Firebase, Appsflyer and Iterable
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect analytics to tangible business outcomes
  • Experience mentoring and developing analysts across different skill levels
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex insights
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary & benefits
  • Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
  • Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
  • Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
  • Support for your ongoing growth & development
  • Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
  • A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days

Our Behaviours

  • Grow others – We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
  • Master it – We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
  • Collaborate – We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
  • Adapt – We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
  • Deliver – Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.

Preferred Qualifications

Location & Working Hours

  • Brazil-based fully remote

What We Offer

  • Market‑aligned compensation with outcome‑based variable tied to GRR/NRR

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go‑live in a PRM or partner‑portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time‑to‑first‑value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Auxiliar de cozinha
description:
Descrição do cargo

Procuramos auxiliares de cozinha profissionais, rápidos e com experiência na área gastronômica para completar a nossa equipe de cozinha, seguindo as especificações e diretrizes dos nossos sous chefs e Chefs Executivos. O papel do auxiliar de cozinha é de ajudar no preparo dos pratos, garantir a limpeza e organização das praças, da cozinha e do estoque, assim como a garantir, junto do resto da equipe, a qualidade dos pedidos e insumos preparados. O auxiliar de cozinha é responsável também pelo cumprimento dos procedimentos internos e de higiene e conservação de alimentos. Os candidatos aprovados empregarão suas habilidades culinárias e de organização para nos ajudar a garantir que o nosso padrão esteja 100% Purgatório!

Responsabilidades

  • Manter todas as superfícies de trabalho da cozinha (balcões, pias, fornos, paredes) limpas e higienizadas;
  • Varrer e esfregar os pisos no início e fim dos turnos;
  • Limpeza e organização das praças;
  • Reposição de produtos no começo e final do expediente;
  • Trabalhar para que a cozinha opere dentro de prazos que atendam aos nossos prazos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Estar pronto para limpar derramamentos para evitar dificuldade nas operações;
  • Lavar panelas, utensílios e talheres rapidamente para mantê-los disponíveis;
  • Colaborar para que a abertura e fechamento da casa aconteçam sempre no horário e nos procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Sinalizar para o líder quais suprimentos precisam de reposição no estoque;
  • Seguir e respeitar os regulamentos sanitários e normas de segurança;
  • Organizar as entregas de equipamentos e ingredientes;
  • Manter organizadas as áreas de alimentos e suprimentos;
  • Seguir todos procedimentos e fichas técnicas para garantir a qualidade do trabalho e do produto;
  • Retirar o lixo;
  • Ajudar com tarefas de rotina de preparo de alimentos (como descascar e picar legumes);
  • Manipulação e preparo de insumos, quando e conforme solicitado;
  • Manter uma abordagem positiva e profissional com colegas e clientes;
  • Sinalização para a liderança caso ativos da empresa precisem de manutenção.

Requisitos

  • Ser um aprendiz rápido e com interesse no trabalho da cozinha;
  • Conhecimento básico dos métodos culinários, ingredientes, equipamentos e procedimentos de cozinha;
  • Capacidade de permanecer em pé por longos períodos;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir as normas de saúde e segurança;
  • Boas habilidades organizacionais;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sem supervisão em um ambiente movimentado;
  • É desejável ter experiência anterior na cozinha de restaurantes;
  • É desejável ter ensino médio completo;

Habilidades e Skills

  • Precisão e rapidez ao executar suas tarefas;
  • Comunicação: Capacidade de comunicar claramente com a equipe de cozinha e manter um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo;
  • Execução: Capacidade em ouvir comandos e executá-los com precisão e rapidez;
  • Organização: Ter senso de organização, ordem e limpeza;
  • Disposição: Ter vontade e disposição física para o serviço;
  • Inteligência emocional: compreender as próprias emoções e as emoções dos outros para construir relacionamentos, resolver conflitos, compreender as necessidades dos colegas e clientes;
  • Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças de última hora, ajustar-se a novas situações e resolver problemas de forma criativa;
  • Conseguir trabalhar bem sob pressão, com prazos curtos e com alta demanda;
  • Gostar de preparar pratos culinários;
  • Ter iniciativa e ser proativo;
  • Saber trabalhar em equipe;
  • Ser uma pessoa paciente e confiável.

title: Líder de Sucesso do Cliente Sênior
description:
Na Winx, acreditamos que tecnologia só gera impacto real quando é bem implementada, bem acompanhada e verdadeiramente adotada pelas pessoas. Por isso, Sucesso do Cliente é um pilar estratégico do nosso crescimento.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para liderar a área de Sucesso do Cliente, com experiência em startups de tecnologia, que saiba equilibrar visão estratégica, gestão de time e atuação prática junto aos clientes.

SOBRE O DESAFIO

Você será responsável por liderar um time pequeno, altamente próximo e engajado, garantindo que nossos clientes extraiam o máximo valor das soluções da Winx ao longo de toda a jornada. Em um contexto de empresa enxuta, este é um papel de liderança “mão na massa”, com forte atuação no dia a dia, proximidade com clientes e colaboração constante com Produto, Tech e Comercial.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time de Sucesso do Cliente, criando um ambiente de alta performance, confiança e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Atuar como principal responsável pela experiência do cliente, desde o onboarding até a retenção e expansão.
  • Garantir clareza, alinhamento e excelência na entrega dos serviços e funcionalidades da solução Winx.
  • Construir e acompanhar indicadores de sucesso do cliente, como adoção, satisfação, churn e health score.
  • Atuar diretamente com clientes estratégicos, conduzindo reuniões, alinhamentos e planos de sucesso.
  • Traduzir necessidades e feedbacks dos clientes em insumos claros para os times de Produto e Tecnologia.
  • Estruturar processos de Sucesso do Cliente compatíveis com um contexto de crescimento, sem perder agilidade.
  • Garantir disponibilidade para atender clientes de acordo com suas necessidades, respeitando o modelo remoto.

O QUE BUSCAMOS

  • Experiência prévia liderando equipes de Sucesso do Cliente em startups de tecnologia ou empresas de software.
  • Forte capacidade de relacionamento, comunicação clara e empática, inclusive em contextos desafiadores.
  • Visão estratégica combinada com capacidade de execução prática.
  • Excelente entendimento de entregáveis de soluções tecnológicas e da jornada do cliente em produtos SaaS.
  • Perfil organizado, com boa capacidade de priorização e gestão em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Conforto em trabalhar em empresas enxutas, com autonomia, proximidade entre áreas e alto senso de responsabilidade.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA NA WINX

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Um time pequeno, muito próximo, colaborativo e altamente engajado.
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e evoluir a área de Sucesso do Cliente.
  • Contato direto com liderança, Produto e Tecnologia.
  • A oportunidade de gerar impacto concreto em clientes relevantes e em uma HR Tech em crescimento.

Se você gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, acredita em relações de longo prazo com clientes e quer liderar Sucesso do Cliente de forma estratégica e próxima, a Winx pode ser o seu próximo desafio.

title: Viral Video Content Creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role. We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads.

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools

Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily

Success Criteria

First 30 days: Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.

Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).

Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).

Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.

By 90 days Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.

Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).

Maintain a simple testing system : what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.

Become independent : you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.

By 12 months Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.

Have a documented system another creator could follow.

Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.

What You Will Do

  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations : new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).

Who You Are

  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting : hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.

Core Values

  • Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.
  • Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.
  • Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.
  • Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.
  • Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.

Offer Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

Your portfolio (required if you have it)

A short note on your AI + editing workflow

2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Lead Generation Hub (LGH) connects top-tier talent with growing U.S. companies by helping them build a high-quality pipeline. Our clients come to us because they need consistent, qualified meetings, and they stay because our process is intelligent, results-driven, and without any BS. What sets LGH apart is our selective, performance-based network. Everyone who joins us is rigorously evaluated through interviews and practical tests that measure real outbound ability, not only theory and whatever is on your resume. We care about what you can actually do. If you don’t meet every requirement but truly believe you can perform at a high level, apply and reach out to us. We value grit, ownership, and confidence.

What will you be doing as a BDR at LGH?

You’ll work remotely as a full-time or part-time Business Development Representative for US companies. That means you won’t be prospecting for LGH itself, but for our clients. Your day-to-day will focus on identifying, prospecting, and engaging potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with decision-makers, all through outbound outreach. Cold calling is at the heart of our methodology, supported by social and email outreach. You’ll also run weekly pipeline reviews with clients to ensure alignment and progress. All the tools, training, and methodology will be provided. At the same time, we encourage you to bring your own experience, tactics, and learned strategies to do your job and improve the process.

Qualifications

  • Advanced English. You’ll be cold-calling and selling in English every day.
  • You must have experience cold calling prospects outside of Brazil/LATAM, preferably to US companies.
  • Proficiency in B2B outbound lead generation techniques, with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment, with good time management skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills for identifying and qualifying high-value leads.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and lead management tools.
  • Nice-to-have: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is advantageous.

Core Qualifications

  • Can you walk into a bar or social event and talk to anyone while enjoying it?
  • Can you handle rejection all day and still pick up the phone with energy on the next call?
  • Can you sit in front of your computer and make calls, one after another, for hours?

Interview Steps:

1) Interview with a recruiter at LGH

2) Panel interview with LGH leadership

3) Speak to a sales psychologist (if necessary)

4) Take a PAID practical assessment.

– This isn’t a simulation. You’ll have a few hours to build a live pipeline for a real LGH client. The session is paid ($7.00 USD/hour), and for most candidates, it lasts around 2 hours.

5) Final Evaluation. Only candidates who pass every stage are invited into the LGH elite network. Once you’re in, we build your sales-focused resume and represent you to our U.S. clients to help ensure a consistent stream of work and income.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle Level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best : building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.

Our HR Manager will take a hands‑on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work / collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G‑Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workloadGood level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900 / year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

  • Strong customer service, analytical, and problem resolution skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communications skills at all levels.
  • Ability to be a team player, with strong organisational & time management skills.
  • Familiarity with Service Now (ITSM) will be an added advantage.
  • 2‑to‑4‑year college degree in information technology or related field.
  • Microsoft and Apple technical certification would be desirable.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Company Description

Outroll is a software holding company that specializes in managing, building, and acquiring software products. With a focus on turning legacy systems, custom tools, and internal software into efficient solutions, we provide a permanent home for software. Our digital infrastructure, development frameworks, and distributed workforce enable us to create world‑class digital products and ventures.

About the Role

We're seeking a talented Senior Full‑Stack Developer to join our remote team on a permanent full‑time contract basis. This fully remote position is open to candidates based in Brazil, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere while contributing to exciting projects. You'll play a key role in architecting, developing, and maintaining robust web applications, collaborating with cross‑functional teams in an agile environment. This is an opportunity to work on scalable platforms that emphasize security, performance, and seamless user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable back‑end architectures using PHP frameworks, ensuring high performance, security, and extensibility.
  • Develop responsive front‑end interfaces with modern JavaScript tools and CSS frameworks, focusing on intuitive UX/UI.
  • Manage database schemas, ORM integrations, and data migrations for efficient data handling.
  • Set up and optimize DevOps pipelines, including CI/CD, containerization, and cloud infrastructure configurations.
  • Collaborate in agile sprints to refine features, conduct testing (unit, integration, UAT), and iterate based on feedback.
  • Ensure compliance with security best practices, including authentication, access controls, and performance optimizations.
  • Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing within a global team.

Requirements

  • Proven experience (5+ years) as a full‑stack developer, with strong expertise in PHP and Symfony (versions 6-8).
  • Proficiency in back‑end technologies like Doctrine ORM, Twig templating, and asynchronous processing.
  • Solid front‑end skills with tools such as Turbo, Stimulus, Tailwind CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with database management (e.g., relational databases like SQLite or similar), schema design, and migrations.
  • Experience in agile methodologies, with the ability to adapt to flexible project scopes and sprints.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code.
  • Excellent English communication skills for collaborating with an international team.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Must be based in Brazil and eligible to work on a full‑time contract basis.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work with flexible hours to support work‑life balance.
  • Permanent full‑time contract with opportunities for long‑term growth in a venture‑building environment.
  • Collaborative culture with access to ongoing training, support, and the latest tools.
  • The chance to work on innovative projects that make a difference, backed by a team of experts.

Remuneration

The remuneration will be based on experience and productivity.

Location

This role requires that the candidate is located in Brazil and have full working rights.

title: Staff Engineer – Ia Generativa
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Você fará parte do time de AI e será uma das principais referências técnicas da área na Remessa Online. Buscamos alguém que respire inovação, tenha resiliência, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de atuar em cenários ambíguos e em constante evolução.

Como Staff Engineer de AI, você será responsável por definir a visão técnica de AI da companhia e conectá-la diretamente aos nossos desafios de negócio, B2B, B2C, operações, marketing, compliance e muito mais.

  • Dar continuidade e construir uma arquitetura de AI para suportar a implementação de inteligência artificial dentro dos times de desenvolvimento e dos times de negócio;
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de AI de ponta a ponta, desde a exploração (discovery, spikes, POCs) até a implantação em produção e evolução contínua;
  • Trabalhar próximo de Produto, Dados, Operações, Marketing e demais times de Engenharia para identificar oportunidades reais de uso de AI que gerem impacto em receita, eficiência e experiência do cliente;
  • Apoiar a construção de produtos como chatbots executivos, copilotos internos, soluções de automação operacional e modelos de recomendação, sempre com foco em geração de valor mensurável;
  • Desenhar e evoluir a arquitetura de AI (modelos, pipelines, MLOps, observabilidade, segurança, governança de dados) garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e compliance;
  • Ser mentor(a) técnico(a) para outros engenheiros(as), disseminando boas práticas de AI / ML, engenharia de software e arquitetura em múltiplos times;
  • Atuar forte em discovery técnico : conduzir spikes, avaliar trade-offs de modelos (LLMs, modelos clássicos de ML, modelos proprietários vs open source) e apoiar decisões de build vs buy;
  • Ajudar a definir padrões, guidelines e frameworks internos para uso de AI, incluindo boas práticas de prompt engineering, avaliação de modelos, uso de vetores, privacidade e proteção de dados;
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, da concepção de produto e da arquitetura de soluções, garantindo coerência entre requisitos funcionais, não-funcionais e as capacidades dos modelos;

Incentivar documentação técnica clara (arquitetura, decisões, modelos, pipelines) e promover melhoria contínua no nosso codebase e na nossa plataforma de AI.

Nos preocupamos com coerência, segurança e responsabilidade no uso de AI. Usamos spikes e slack time para experimentar novas ideias, validar hipóteses e reduzir risco técnico antes de escalar soluções. Buscamos sempre pensar “fora da caixa”, mas com disciplina de engenharia e métricas de impacto bem definidas.

O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Forte base em arquitetura e design de software (Domain-Driven Design, design de APIs, event-driven, microsserviços etc.);
  • Experiência prática construindo soluções de Machine Learning e / ou LLMs em produção (modelos de classificação, recomendação, NLP, generative AI, RAG etc.);
  • Conhecimento em modelos Classificadores / Decisores;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados vetorizados e baseados em Grafos(pgvector, pgrouting, Neo4J, ApacheAGE);
  • Experiência em observabilidade em aplicações GenAI e / ou integrações com modelos de ML;
  • Conhecimento em NodeJs / TypeScript ou Python;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia (TDD, clean code, testes automatizados);
  • Experiência com FinMLOps : versionamento de modelos e dados, experiment tracking, CI / CD para modelos, monitoramento de drift e performance, pipelines de treinamento e inferência;
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas de LLM e boas práticas de uso (prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de qualidade, custo e latência);

Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo! Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil.

Movimentar é o nosso esporte.

Desenvolvimento de dashboards em Power BI.

Regime de contratação

PJ por escopo de projeto fechado OU por horas trabalhadas OU fixo mensal.
